typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		data_mart as string,
		phn as double,
		name_first_middle as string,
		name_last as string,
		birth_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		gender as string,
		beg_effective_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		end_effective_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		request_source as string,
		patient_row_id as string,
		flag_1 as string,
		date_1 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		date_2 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		flag_2 as string,
		text_1 as string,
		text_2 as string,
		number_1 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		number_2 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> PMSPatientInputFiles
PMSPatientInputFiles derive({Copy of number_1} = toInteger(number_1),
		{Copy of phn} = toString(phn),
		{Copy of beg_effective_date} = beg_effective_date,
		{Copy of end_effective_date} = end_effective_date,
		{Copy of number_2} = toInteger(number_2),
		{Copy of request_source} = toString(request_source),
		{Copy of text_1} = toString(text_1),
		{Copy of date_1} = date_1,
		{Copy of date_2} = date_2,
		{Copy of name_last} = toString(name_last),
		{Copy of flag_1} = toString(flag_1),
		{Copy of flag_2} = toString(flag_2),
		{Copy of birth_date} = birth_date,
		{Copy of gender} = toString(gender),
		{Copy of text_2} = toString(text_2),
		{Copy of data_mart} = toString(data_mart),
		{Copy of name_first_middle} = toString(name_first_middle),
		{Copy of patient_row_id} = toString(patient_row_id)) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive({Copy of data_mart} = {Copy of data_mart}) ~> PlaceHolderSCTpopulatepatientnbr
PlaceHolderSCTpopulatepatientnbr sink(input(
		gender as string,
		text_1 as string,
		birth_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		name_last as string,
		request_source as string,
		date_2 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		date_1 as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		flag_2 as string,
		flag_1 as string,
		number_2 as integer,
		number_1 as integer,
		patient_row_id as string,
		phn as string,
		beg_effective_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		text_2 as string,
		end_effective_date as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		patient_nbr as integer,
		name_first_middle as string,
		data_mart as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		gender = {Copy of gender},
		text_1 = {Copy of text_1},
		birth_date = {Copy of birth_date},
		name_last = {Copy of name_last},
		request_source = {Copy of request_source},
		date_2 = {Copy of date_2},
		date_1 = {Copy of date_1},
		flag_2 = {Copy of flag_2},
		flag_1 = {Copy of flag_1},
		number_2 = {Copy of number_2},
		number_1 = {Copy of number_1},
		patient_row_id = {Copy of patient_row_id},
		phn = {Copy of phn},
		beg_effective_date = {Copy of beg_effective_date},
		text_2 = {Copy of text_2},
		end_effective_date = {Copy of end_effective_date},
		patient_nbr = patientNbr,
		name_first_middle = {Copy of name_first_middle},
		data_mart = {Copy of data_mart})) ~> ecmspmspatient
DataConversion sink(input(
		{} as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> ExcelDestination
